title: Not for Coffee
text: Not for Coffee. The Tardis Mug makes a good addition to my desk but unfortunately though I can't use it for beverages. I just can't get the hang of drinking out of something has a straight side and I kept spilling coffee on myself. I did find it makes a good pencil holder though.

product_metadata.title: Doctor Who Tardis Mug | Official Square Shaped Ceramic Coffee Mug With Lid | Holds 17-Ounces Of Your Favorite Coffee, Tea, Or Other Drink
features: EXCELLENT FOR SPACE AND TIME TRAVEL: Travelling with the Doctor? Surely you'll need a suitable mug to quench your thirst! What better than this sculpted ceramic mug for your favorite teas and coffee?
STRONG CERAMIC COFFEE MUG WITH LID: Sculpted from rigid ceramic, this tea mug is worthy of any thrilling Doctor Who adventure! You won't need a sonic screwdriver to fix this tough mug!

LARGE MUG FIT FOR ANY DOCTOR: Coming in at a whopping 17 Oz. capacity, this mug holds over 2 cups of your favorite drink! Kick off your favorite season of Doctor Who with this ceramic mug at your side!
NOT YOUR ORDINARY COFFEE MUG: This mug is for the ultimate Doctor Who fan! This whimsical ceramic travel mug shaped like a Tardis will take you to a whole new dimension of style with every sip!

OFFICIALLY LICENSED: If you're looking for that bit of Doctor Who merchandise to complete your collection, look no further! This Tardis mug is officially licensed and is practically pleading with you to take it home!
description: Fun 16oz Jumbo Mug shaped as a Tardis. Comes with a removable lid. Ideal for a Dr Who Lover
